scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with product tagline, compelling headline, and primary/secondary CTAs (REQ-1, REQ-3, US-1)

steps.description: Open the application root URL (/) in a browser
Check that the hero section is immediately visible in the viewport without scrolling
Confirm a clear headline explaining the URL shortening service is displayed with supporting subheadline
Check that 'Get Started' and 'Login' buttons are prominently displayed

test_cases.expected: Hero section component renders with h1 headline containing URL shortening related text
Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' or 'Get Started Free' is present
Secondary CTA button with text 'Login' is present and styled differently from primary
Subheadline text explaining the benefit of the service is displayed below headline

Each feature card contains a title (h3) and description text
